title: draw/flow/win share byte-identical .log.bin blobs both before and after the change
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/draw.log.bin b/goldens/draw.log.bin
index b0a2f10..b4bc1c2 100644
Binary files a/goldens/draw.log.bin and b/goldens/draw.log.bin differ
diff --git a/goldens/flow.log.bin b/goldens/flow.log.bin
index b0a2f10..b4bc1c2 100644
Binary files a/goldens/flow.log.bin and b/goldens/flow.log.bin differ
diff --git a/goldens/win.log.bin b/goldens/win.log.bin
index b0a2f10..b4bc1c2 100644
Binary files a/goldens/win.log.bin and b/goldens/win.log.bin differ
detail: Three distinct demos produce identical binary logs (same old blob b0a2f10, same new blob b4bc1c2) while their .t1 traces differ per demo. Either the log is a shared stub or golden generation copy-pasted content.
recommended_fix: Verify the golden generator writes per-demo log content; regenerate and confirm distinct blobs, or document the shared-artifact invariant explicitly.

title: Ten golden updates are opaque binary blobs; contents cannot be audited from the diff
evidence:
Binary files a/goldens/boot.log.bin and b/goldens/boot.log.bin differ
Binary files a/goldens/bundle.log.bin and b/goldens/bundle.log.bin differ
detail: Binary goldens can hide arbitrary content — no reviewer can tell whether they were regenerated legitimately or hand-patched to pass. The .t1 traces are the only auditable record.
recommended_fix: Document how .log.bin goldens are generated and validated in CI; treat the text .t1 traces as the primary reviewable golden.

title: All traces fully regenerated with unchanged seed/logic_hz; diff carries no rationale for the global behavior change
detail: With seed 42 and tick counts unchanged, every per-tick hash changed and catalog_hash moved. That is a global determinism change; this chunk provides no explanation tying it to a code change.
recommended_fix: State in the commit message which behavior change forced full golden regeneration, and confirm the new traces were machine-generated, not hand-edited.
